extension.description: Everything moves on circles: posters glide along a large arc into the lens, data is drawn as rings and gauges like a precision instrument (rating sweep, runtime clock sector that shows when the film ends tonight, circular scrubber). Blue-black ground, one signal-amber accent, wide Archivo headings and JetBrains Mono numerals. Built for the NVIDIA Shield (Kodi 21 Omega).
extension.news: v0.9.23 - Counts read right at one: 1 episode, 1 film, 1 artist, 1 track, 1 item. Smaller download: removed images the skin never used. v0.9.22 - Keyboard: Symbols, Caps and Shift fit their keys again (Shift was cut to "Shi..." and the labels ran into their tick boxes).
